comment: Menu item names read out of 2.4.1's appendContextMenu code. The selection-input label is built at runtime from the module's own word plus ' selection input:', so it prints as Phrase selection input: on Drummer and Melody and Song selection input: on Timeline; somebody should confirm the capital. The CV/menu control with its Instant and End of phrase choices sits among the editor window's controls, not in appendContextMenu, so its line says the editor window. Light theme and Dark theme are on every module in the plugin and are cosmetic, so they get no line anywhere, Follower included.
